gates.parity_test: 2/2 pass — asserts heading + body + two labelled buttons, the SAME facts the web browser gate asserts
gates.negative_case: a malformed document renders a visible error rather than an empty surface
gates.idempotent: second run is a no-op; one asset entry, three lib files, parity still green
gates.self_verifying: the scaffolder RUNS the parity test before reporting success and exits 1 if it fails

decisions.decision: Build in artifact-refiner as scaffold-flutter-a2ui.sh, not in hybrid-mobile-architecture-src
decisions.rationale: This repo owns A2UI protocol knowledge (v1.0 schema, v0.9 translation, catalog quirks); the mobile project owns app generation. Forking protocol knowledge across repos is how gen_ui_types came to define an A2uiEvent that models an AG-UI run stream. Parity is also only testable where both hosts live.
decisions.cost: Two repos must stay in step. Mitigated by reading the package name from pubspec.yaml rather than assuming, and failing loudly on an unexpected layout.

decisions.rationale: a2ui_flutter@0.0.1-wip002 is 1890 bytes — an unmodified `dart create` template (class Awesome { bool get isAwesome => true; }), README 'TODO: add readme'. It is a reserved name with no implementation. genui@0.10.2 is the real renderer: 77 files, 11377 LOC, 12 widget classes, same catalog vocabulary and same version number as @a2ui/react@0.10.2.

parity_seam.note: The v1.0->v0.9 translation now exists in THREE places and all must agree.
parity_seam.both_halves_required: retarget catalogId or the renderer raises 'Catalog not found'; split v1.0's inline components/dataModel or the surface is created but never populated and renders EMPTY with no error

carry_forward: A2uiEvent in hybrid-mobile-architecture-src/assets/templates/rust/gen_ui_types/src/events.rs:81 models an AG-UI-shaped run lifecycle (RunStarted/RunFinished/RunError) under an A2UI name. Zero overlap with A2UI's six operations. Frozen seam with consumers outside this repo — ESCALATED, not fixed.
genui@0.10.2 resolves a2ui_core@0.0.1-wip002, not the published 0.1.1. Works; a bump is a change to verify, not assume.
The Dart SDK constraint is >=3.10.0; verified on Flutter 3.48.0 beta / Dart 3.14.0.
